models.label: RocketFins narrow3 adapted
models.conversion: Project centerline foil to a 92 mm cylindrical body: root=Hcenter+(Htip-Hcenter)*46/90; span=90-46; sweep=0.3*(root-tip). Chords uniformly enlarged when root is below the 35 mm adapter minimum.
assumptions: 1.5 L capacity, 320 mm body and 100 mm nose are host assumptions, not a dimensioned original vehicle.
Flat solid 2.4 mm fins replace NACA0009 sections; source neck-mounted adapter/clearance, threads and exact root are omitted.
1.6 mm conical nose shell and tail placement are host assumptions.
Other dry mass, material, attachment and operating conditions come from the template.
models.cfd_blocker: Current detailed CFD adapter supports four fins only.

models.label: 0.5 L four-fin adapted
models.conversion: cm to mm. Replace rounded/teardrop fins with a host trapezoid: root 35 mm (source 32 mm), tip 10 mm, sweep 22 mm. Replace rounded nose by a 95 mm cone (80 mm cap + 15 mm glue zone). These shape changes are approximations.
assumptions: 220 mm body length and 40 mm fin tail inset are host assumptions.
7 cm diameter is reported measured by the source author; our manufactured part remains unmeasured.
Uniform 4 mm solid fins replace the tapered rounded source section.
Other dry mass, material, attachment and operating conditions come from the template.

models.label: waterRocketToolbox 1.5 L parameter adaptation
models.conversion: Only capacity and diameter from simulator constants are adopted; this is not the FreeCAD multi-bottle assembly.
assumptions: Body length, all fin/nose geometry, material and attachment are host assumptions.
Source bottle mass is not a total dry mass; retain the template other-dry-mass budget.
Source launch pressure, nozzle, computers/camera masses and aerodynamic coefficient are not imported.
The single-reservoir adapter does not reproduce staged or multi-bottle vehicles.
